why: Dumping {a: 1} with flowLevel 0 and flowSkipColonSpace on gives `{a:1}` on head, and the project's own load reads that back as {'a:1': null}, so the round-trip silently changes the data; on base the key is quoted (`{"a":1}`) and the data comes back as {a: 1}.
